Off Calendar Apr-28-2006 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES:
NO APPEARANCE. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED with modification. Plaintiff's motion to compel responses to form and special interrogatories and to compel an inspection of property is granted. No opposition has been filed. Defendant is ordered to serve complete verified responses without objection within 15 days of notice of this order. Defendant is also ordered to contact counsel for plaintiff to schedule an inspection of the premises. The inspection is to be completed within 15 days of notice of this order. Failure to respond to written discovery and to permit an inspection was a misuse of the discovery process. Monetary sanctions in the amount of $715 are to be paid within 30 days of notice of this order.
Modification: To require compliance within 7 days of notice of the order.
COMMISSIONER: BRUCE E. CHAN
